newsitem.title: SPAIN: Viscofan outperforms Spain's Ibex-35 as newcomer.
newsitem.headline: Viscofan outperforms Spain's Ibex-35 as newcomer.

text.p: Viscofan shares were outperforming the Spanish market on Tuesday morning after the unexpected announcement yesterday of their re-inclusion in the blue-chip Ibex index of 35 stocks, dealers said.
At the same time news of building company Acciona's exclusion was unexpected, dealers added.
"The changes in Ibex-35 brought two surprises, the positive one was for Viscofan, the negative one was Acciona," a trader said.
At 0840 GMT, sausage skin-maker Viscofan was up 7.23 percent to 3,485 pesetas and the other two newcomers were also gaining. The Ibex-35 was trading down 0.7 percent at 6,752.66.
Viscofan was excluded from the Ibex last December.
Acciona, the new group after the merger of Cubiertas and Entrecanales, was off 4.18 percent to 17,200.
Steel tube producer Tubacex, which widely outperformed the market yesterday, shed 0.23 percent to 439, and zinc producer Asturiana de Zinc was unchanged.

The other two shares to leave the index, Metrovacesa and Gesa were also underperforming the index. The first one was down 1.94 percent to 5,550 pesetas and the second shed 1.24 percent to 8,050 pesetas.
The changes to the Ibex-35 component companies will be effective from July 1.

The constituent companies of the Ibex index are reassessed twice yearly in January and July by a committee made up of five representatives from the Stock Exchange authority, the MEFF futures exchange and market experts. The committee does not make public the criteria it uses.
